text: Chapter 14: Mainland Toram@The Uncouth Rana Prince
You have returned to the ark. You want to go meet Mare and\nAga as soon as possible, but you don't how to get to the\nmeeting point. Anono seems to know it. Go to Latum Wetlands!
You arrive at Latum Wetlands only to find Coenubia monsters\nroaming the area. Beat them and find Mare and Aga!
You reunite with Mare and Aga, but you're struggling against\nCoenubias that have built up tolerance to water. Team up\nwith the mysterious Ranas that show up to beat the enemies!
Unda helps you and Mare tells him that the council wants\nthem to join forces. However he still wants to observe your\nabilities. Follow him to Aquastida!
You arrive at Aquastida only to find Coenubias that have\ncompletely adapted to live in water. Beat them and keep\ngoing!
You arrive at a vast area. Following Unda's warning, you\nlook up and see a mermaid-like Coenubia attacking from\nabove. Defeat Biskyva!
